mapper.select: SELECT id, sno, username, type, college, major, birth, originPlace, password, graduated FROM student WHERE sno = #{sno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (sno, username, type, college, major, birth, originPlace, password, graduated) VALUES (#{sno}, #{username}, #{type}, #{college}, #{major}, #{birth}, #{originPlace}, #{password}, #{graduated})
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET password = #{password} WHERE sno = #{sno}
